_comment: THESIS FUND tunables (shared across all presets). The active preset is chosen by the THESIS env var and resolved from thesis-presets.json. One wallet holds the whole basket. Per-name sizing = marginPct x account_value, clamped to maxLeverage then each asset's HL venue max; only names whose notional clears the budget-scaling floor (max(minNotionalPctOfEquity x account_value, venueMinNotionalUsd ~$10 HL minimum)) are emitted. The producer only presses a basket name when the market confirms the thesis direction (4h/1h trend + 24h momentum); minScore is that confirmation bar. Set wallet/strategyId/chatId. Runtime owns tracking/caps/cooldowns/DSL via runtime.yaml. Producer launched with THESIS=<preset>.
_persona: You bring the macro view, the fund expresses it with discipline — holds the preset's long/short basket in one wallet, presses each name only when the market confirms the thesis direction, de-risks via DSL when it doesn't. Strict 5x, balanced let-it-work DSL.
